title: Buddy Petit: great but unrecorded, and sending Morand as substitute
summary: Buddy Petit was a great trumpeter who never recorded. Always late, he sent Morand to cover jobs across the lake until he arrived on a later train.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: How did Buddy Petit rank as a trumpeter?
He was one of the great trumpeters? Yeah. He never recorded, did he?

No, he never recorded at all. He used to send me on many jobs, because he'd always be late. So he'd send me to play in his place until he came, like, across the lake, over Mandeville, Bita Springs, different places like that, I'd play until he came over on the later train.
You played a lot of out of town jobs?
Yeah, in and out of the state.
